claims.text: Station details
claims.note: Tile title. The expandable sprinkler rows under a multi-sprinkler station.

claims.text: Per-sprinkler readings under a multi-head station.
claims.note: Tile summary. A station's sprinkler records share its name and are grouped under one row (sa-dash-table.component.ts:355-408); each record gets a child row with its own reading (sa-table-card.component.html:74-98). 373-1135 rev 02 §Table Functionality: "Expandable rows for multi-sprinkler stations".

claims.text: Some stations drive more than one sprinkler.
claims.note: Each TurfRad sprinkler is stored as its own record, matched on hole, name and coordinates (SpatialAdjustService.cs:2676-2705), so two sprinklers with the same station name become two records of one station, grouped into one table row (sa-dash-table.component.ts:355-408). 373-1135 rev 02 §Map Indicators speaks of stations that have more than one sprinkler.

claims.text: Expand the row to see what each head actually measured.
claims.note: Each child row shows its own reading: today's scan mean when that sprinkler was scanned today, otherwise the modelled value with an orange calculator under Option 2, or "--" under Option 1 (sa-table-card.component.html:88-91). A child shows what it measured only if it was scanned today; see station-details/4/2.

claims.text: Table, station rows
claims.note: Retyped from behaviour to navigation. Station rows appear after you drill from an area into a hole (sa-dash-table.component.ts:347-411), and only a station row can carry the chevron (sa-table-card.component.html:16).

claims.text: The Spatial Adjust dashboard, at /spatialadjust, with the table showing the stations of one hole.
claims.note: Start state. The route is /spatialadjust (app-routing.module.ts:19-23). Station rows appear after you drill from an area into a hole (sa-dash-table.component.ts:347-411), and only a station row can carry the chevron (sa-table-card.component.html:16).

claims.text: No dialog open.
claims.note: Start state. Both dashboard dialogs, Push Changes and Settings, are drawn only while their flag is set, and both flags start false (sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:67-68; sa-main-toolbar.component.html:94-112).

claims.text: A Spatial Adjust account on a site with TurfRad scan data.
claims.note: Start state. Same prerequisite as dashboard-overview/before/1: a Spatial Adjust user on a site with TurfRad scan data.

claims.text: Only a station with more than one sprinkler paired to it can be expanded.
claims.note: Start state. Same fact as station-details/before/1: the chevron and the child rows are rendered only for a station with more than one sprinkler record (sa-table-card.component.html:16, :74).

claims.text: Only stations with more than one paired sprinkler can be expanded — the rest have nothing underneath.
claims.note: Retyped from prerequisite to behaviour; the source settles it. The chevron and the child rows are rendered only for a station row with more than one sprinkler record (sa-table-card.component.html:16, :74), and only such rows are given children (sa-dash-table.component.ts:402-408).

claims.text: Spot the expandable rows
claims.note: Step title.

claims.text: Look down the station names in the table for a chevron beside one.
claims.note: The chevron icon is drawn in the station name area, in front of the name, only for a station row with more than one sprinkler record (sa-table-card.component.html:16-23).

claims.text: A chevron sits between the row’s checkbox and the station name.
claims.note: A right-pointing chevron sits between the row checkbox and the station name (sa-table-card.component.html:6-23; sa-table-card.component.less:33-35).

claims.text: If no station has a chevron, none of them has more than one sprinkler.
claims.note: Without a second sprinkler record there is no chevron and no child row (sa-table-card.component.html:16, :74).

claims.text: There is nothing to expand here.
claims.note: Without a second sprinkler record there is no chevron and no child row (sa-table-card.component.html:16, :74).

claims.text: Station 6AP1 has a chevron: more than one sprinkler.
claims.note: Figure caption. The station name is the figure's sample data.

claims.text: Expand the station
claims.note: Step title. Clicking the chevron toggles the row (sa-table-card.component.ts:306-309). The child rows are always rendered, and the row's height limit grows from 50 px to 500 px when it is expanded (sa-table-card.component.less:15, :25-27). Clicking the station name selects the station rather than expanding it (sa-table-card.component.html:22).

claims.text: Select the chevron beside the station name.
claims.note: The chevron toggles the row open (sa-table-card.component.html:16-21; sa-table-card.component.ts:306-309). It has no text label, so the step is a region step.

claims.text: Each sprinkler shows on its own row, named for the station and numbered, with its own scan date and moisture.
claims.note: A child row reads <station>-1, <station>-2 in list order, with its own latest scan date and its own VWC (sa-table-card.component.html:76-92).

claims.text: If the row did not open, you selected the station name, which only selects the station.
claims.note: Selecting the station name selects the station and does not expand it; the chevron does (sa-table-card.component.html:16-22; sa-table-card.component.ts:290-309).

claims.text: Select the chevron.
claims.note: Selecting the station name selects the station and does not expand it; the chevron does (sa-table-card.component.html:16-22; sa-table-card.component.ts:290-309).

claims.text: Nothing else is editable at sprinkler level, because the target and the adjustment belong to the station.
claims.note: Reworded from station-details/2/3: a child row has no input or switch, and the target and the adjustment belong to the station (sa-table-card.component.html:76-97; SpatialAdjustService.cs:1218-1229, :3024-3028).

claims.text: Two sprinklers under 6AP1, each with its own reading.
claims.note: Figure caption. The station name is the figure's sample data.

claims.text: The parent value is an average
claims.note: Step title. A multi-sprinkler station's Avg. VWC is the plain mean of its sprinklers that were scanned today or are modelled (sa-dash-table.component.ts:369-383), shown to one decimal place (sa-table-card.component.ts:373-378). The frontend computes it; no API arithmetic is involved.

claims.text: Compare the station’s [[Avg. VWC]] with the readings on its sprinkler rows.
claims.note: SPATIAL_ADJUST.AVG_VWC "Avg. VWC" heads the column at station level (sa-dash-table.component.html:9; en-us.json:377).

claims.text: The station shows the mean of its sprinklers, so 31.4 and 30.4 give 30.9.
claims.note: The station value is the plain mean of its sprinklers, shown to one decimal: (31.4 + 30.4) / 2 = 30.9 (sa-dash-table.component.ts:369-383; sa-table-card.component.ts:373-378).

claims.text: If the average is not the mean of every row below it, a sprinkler was left out.
claims.note: The mean is unweighted and counts only sprinklers scanned today or, under Option 2, modelled (sa-dash-table.component.ts:369-383). Under Option 1 a sprinkler not scanned today is left out, and if none qualifies the cell shows "--".

claims.text: Only sprinklers scanned today, or modelled under [[Option 2]], count.
claims.note: The mean is unweighted and counts only sprinklers scanned today or, under Option 2, modelled (sa-dash-table.component.ts:369-383). Under Option 1 a sprinkler not scanned today is left out, and if none qualifies the cell shows "--".

claims.text: A station that looks fine can still hide one dry head.
claims.note: Carried over from station-details/3/4: because the mean is unweighted, one dry sprinkler and one wet one can average to a normal-looking value (sa-dash-table.component.ts:369-383). The agronomic half of the dropped callout (a wide spread is a coverage problem) is not published.

claims.text: Mean of the children, shown on the parent row.
claims.note: Figure caption. The station row's Avg. VWC cell shows the mean (sa-table-card.component.html:29-31).

claims.text: Spot a modelled sprinkler
claims.note: Step title (reworded). A sprinkler not scanned today is modelled under Option 2 only (spatial-adjust-course.model.ts:184-188).

claims.text: Look at the sprinkler rows for an orange calculator icon beside a reading.
claims.note: A modelled child carries an orange calculator icon at the left of its VWC (sa-table-card.component.html:88; sa-table-card.component.less:121-130).

claims.text: That sprinkler’s value is modelled, because its last scan is older than today.
claims.note: A child whose scan is older than today shows a modelled value under Option 2 (sa-table-card.component.html:86-92; spatial-adjust-course.model.ts:184-188). Corrected wording from docs/text-corrections.md §25.

claims.text: If no sprinkler has the icon, each was scanned today, or the site uses [[Option 1]].
claims.note: A child shows its measured value only when scanned today; otherwise the modelled value under Option 2, or "--" under Option 1 (sa-table-card.component.html:88-91). The icon shows only for a modelled child (:88).

claims.text: Under [[Option 1]], a sprinkler not scanned today shows --.
claims.note: A child shows its measured value only when scanned today; otherwise the modelled value under Option 2, or "--" under Option 1 (sa-table-card.component.html:88-91). The icon shows only for a modelled child (:88).

claims.text: The second sprinkler was last scanned two days ago.
claims.note: Figure caption; sample data. Each child row shows its own latest scan date (sa-table-card.component.html:83), and a sprinkler not scanned today is modelled under Option 2 (:88).

claims.text: Check the parent row
claims.note: Step title. The parent row carries the grey calculator icon (sa-table-card.component.html:29-31).

claims.text: Look for a grey calculator icon beside the station’s [[Avg. VWC]].
claims.note: The parent row carries a grey calculator icon beside its Avg. VWC (sa-table-card.component.html:29-31; sa-table-card.component.less:112-116). The sentence splitter cut the label "Avg. VWC" in two; read the two claims together.

claims.text: The icon shows that the average includes a modelled reading.
claims.note: The icon marks an average that includes a modelled reading (sa-table-card.component.html:29-31; sa-table-card.component.ts:398-400). Corrected wording from docs/text-corrections.md §25.

claims.text: If the row has no icon, no sprinkler under it is modelled.
claims.note: The parent icon is drawn only when the row is estimated or has an estimated child (sa-table-card.component.html:29-31), so without it no sprinkler under the row is modelled.

claims.text: The grey icon on the parent row marks an average that includes a modelled reading.
claims.note: Figure caption. The grey icon on the parent row marks an average that includes a modelled reading (sa-table-card.component.html:29-31).

claims.text: You can expand a multi-sprinkler station.
claims.note: The chevron toggles the expansion (sa-table-card.component.ts:306-309).

claims.text: You can tell which child readings are modelled.
claims.note: By the orange calculator icon at the left of the child's VWC (sa-table-card.component.html:88; sa-table-card.component.less:121-130), not by italics; see station-details/4/2. Under Option 1 nothing is modelled and a child not scanned today shows "--".
